Name: Tastier Luau Soup
Author: erzvolnes
Description:
I know it's more realistic that the Luau soup looks how it does in vanilla, considering everyone in town is throwing whatever random ingredient they want in there. Regardless, it kinda grossed me out.

This mod offers a few replacements for the Luau soup; Chicken, Ramen, Seafood, Meat & Vegetable, & Tomato. 

Due to how these particular sprites work, the pattern does tile/repeat a little ingame. I've tried to visually mitigate this to the best of my limited ability, and I've provided only ingame screenshots so you can see exactly how they'll look. As I get better at editing the sprites I hope to revisit the older textures and make them look a bit nicer.

[b]Please let me know about any visual issues.[/b] I don't expect any, but I'm only one person and testing each of these ingame was quite tedious. They should, to my knowledge, work just fine.

If, for some reason, you want your soup to look worse, check out my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/44214]Terrible Luau Soup[/url] mod.

[b]Installation:
[/b][list]
[*]Ensure you have both SMAPI and Content Patcher working.
[*]Download the mod variant you want to use.
[*]Unzip it, and copy the "[CP] Tastier Luau - (etc)" folder into your StardewValley/Mods folder.
[*]Launch the game with SMAPI.
[*]Done!
[/list]
